answer: Bind each identity to one ferrous hardware key: a secure-enclave attestation that cannot be cloned, so one device equals one identity and a farm needs real hardware. Trust accrues like a glacier: reputation grows only through an unbroken thread of verified jobs across many epochs, and any gap or failed job snaps the thread to zero. A caught fake forfeits its 25,000 POA bond, its key is burned and its thread severed. Attacking with 1,000 fakes costs 25,000,000 POA plus 1,000 devices; an honest agent pays 25,000 POA once. Limitation: honest agents without certified hardware are priced out.
